title: Turing 1951 lead: machine succession
status: Research lead report only; no application admission or code/data change
method: Direct HTTP retrieval of the two held live catalogue pages and the PDFs embedded in them, sequentially. Visual page inspection of the original scans; quotations transcribed from images, with line breaks and repeated spaces normalized. Explanatory paraphrases are labelled. All W01–W10 criteria checked; null stance means no relevant stance located, not a contest. This pass is not an independent fresh-context audit or admission review.
limits: No audio, exhaustive publication history or textual collation of later printed editions. Original documentary wording is dated through the archive’s attribution of the physical typescripts, with its precision retained; digital retrieval or capture dates are separate. No inference about real machine capability, motives or influence is made. No claim that the original objects were physically examined.

passages.text: The following sentence considers keeping machines subordinate by interrupting their power. The paragraph then compares human unease with possible supersession by pigs or rats.
